name: Mother Anvil
blurb: Mother Anvil is the biggest anvil of the forge, stood up on four iron legs: dark riveted iron, her top flared and her horn pointing forward, her heart a fire behind iron grates between copper bands, four short legs armoured in plates with clawed feet, and on her top a hinged iron arm holding a great hammer with brass bands and a golden star on each face.
next: the horn's faceted boss standing out more in front, her plates chipped like the sheet's, the heart brighter.
